localised_description: Raised in the stables of a Jarl's hall and barded in felt, mail and horn, the Huscarl Warhorse gives up a little of the Norscan Warhorse's speed for the protection a sworn champion needs in the press of battle.
A crude war-chariot of timber, iron and bone, drawn by a pair of half-wild Norscan horses that care little for what lies beneath their hooves.
